items.title: Twenty Years of jQuery: How a Little Library Rewired Web Development
items.blurb: jQuery, created by John Resig and released in 2006, is a JavaScript library that simplifies HTML manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax. It enabled easier web development by providing an accessible API across browsers.

items.title: Half Past Fetch: What await fetch() Waits For
items.blurb: The fetch promise resolves when the headers have been parsed, while the body is still arriving over an open socket. What that gap does to connections, clone, abort, and timeouts.
